description: Conversational evaluation corpus for Hallie Mae, the VideoScan family-archive chat assistant. 298 questions across twelve categories, written as a real family member would type them. Follow-up items marked followsPrevious must be evaluated in sequence with the item immediately preceding them in this array. Lineage items (ln0xx, added 2026-08-22) cover maternal/paternal lines, surname trees, origin trails and GEDCOM awareness. Birthplace-trail items (lv260902-04x, 2026-09-02) cover the maternal/paternal read-out and the generations-to-Europe count.

expect_values.social: Courteous non-catalog reply. Warm, brief, no invented facts, no unnecessary pivot to the archive.
expect_values.catalog: Evidence-backed answer grounded in the catalog. Numbers and file references must be real or the answer must say the data is not available.
expect_values.kinship: Answer from the family graph (people, relationships, dates).
expect_values.biography: Narrative composed from the knowledge base, attributed, no invented biography.
expect_values.graceful_decline: Should honestly say it does not know, warmly, and offer what it can do instead. Never fabricate.
expect_values.clarify: Should ask which one / what is meant rather than guessing.
